tips.text: Crack relics as fast as you can for Ducats and skip hunting a perfect relic; Void Cascade or quick Capture and Rescue fissures work.
Farm the 300,000 credits at the Techrot Safe in Höllvania or the Index on Neptune, with a Credit Booster and a Credit Blessing.
Farm Ducats and credits in the weeks before a visit; Baro stays only 48 hours.
Try Excavation fissures; several excavators run at once and each can give a relic reward.
Refine to Radiant before cracking and take those relics into public squads for more Uncommon and Rare parts.
Check Baro's stock the moment he lands; if it is missing, keep the Ducats for the next visit.
Bring Chroma with Effigy, a credit booster, a Credit Blessing and a Prosperous Retriever to the Techrot Safe.
Players call this an easy farm; the only pain is timing Baro's stock.
